about: RL-R2: field moves, the Pokémon HMs of a run. A side area (rules.json run.side) sits behind one of them: its obstacle stands on the main path and opens for a Billie of the move's type, once that type's badge is kept (meta.badges, won from a leader of the type). Lines are drafts for the owner: {billie} is the Billie that uses the move, {badge} the badge's name.

surf.name: Surf
surf.look: The water is calm and deep. Something glints on the far side.
surf.needBadge: The water is calm and deep. With the {badge}, a Water Billie could carry you across.
surf.needType: The water is calm and deep. You have the {badge}, but no Water Billie in your team to ride.
surf.ask: The water is calm and deep. Would you like to Surf?
surf.out: A current pulls you along the shore and sets you down on the main path.

smash.name: Rock Smash
smash.look: A cracked boulder blocks a gap in the rock face. A cold draught comes through.
smash.needBadge: A cracked boulder blocks the way. With the {badge}, a Ground Billie could smash it.
smash.needType: A cracked boulder blocks the way. You have the {badge}, but no Ground Billie in your team to smash it.
smash.ask: A cracked boulder blocks the way. Would you like to use Rock Smash?
smash.out: A tunnel slopes up into daylight, back on the main path.
smash.travel: Up the tunnel, toward the daylight…

cut.name: Cut
cut.look: A thorny little tree has grown across the path. It looks like it could be cut.
cut.needBadge: A thorny little tree blocks the path. With the {badge}, a Grass Billie could cut it down.
cut.needType: A thorny little tree blocks the path. You have the {badge}, but no Grass Billie in your team to cut it.
cut.ask: This tree looks like it can be cut down! Would you like to use Cut?
cut.out: A trail through the undergrowth leads back to the main path.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.look: A wall of water crashes down from above.
waterfall.needBadge: A wall of water crashes down from above. With {badges}, a Water Billie could climb it.
waterfall.needType: A wall of water crashes down from above. You have {badges}, but no Water Billie in your team to climb it.
waterfall.ask: It's a large waterfall. Would you like to use Waterfall?
waterfall.top: The water at the top is too rough to come out on.
